title: Windows 365 Cloud PC Deployment & Management
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (provisioning service across Windows 365 + Intune + Entra + networking, image management, licensing, coexistence with physical endpoints).
hook: Give users a full Windows desktop in the cloud — provisioned, secured, and managed from Intune
problem: Contractors, BYOD staff, and offshore teams need a corporate Windows desktop, but shipping and managing a physical laptop for each one is slow and expensive. Windows 365 Cloud PCs give every user a dedicated, always-on Windows desktop streamed from the cloud — provisioned in minutes, joined to your tenant, secured by the same Intune policies as your physical fleet, and reachable from any device. This solution makes that a repeatable, governed deployment instead of a pile of one-off Cloud PCs.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how Windows 365 Enterprise works, the provisioning-policy model, Azure Network Connection (ANC) vs. Microsoft-hosted network, custom vs. gallery images, and how Cloud PCs are managed exactly like physical devices in Intune.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Windows 365 Enterprise licensing, Intune, Entra ID, networking/ANC or Microsoft-hosted, an optional custom image, user group design, Conditional Access) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: licensing and groups, network connection, image, the provisioning policy, user assignment, applying Intune configuration/compliance/app policies to Cloud PCs, securing access, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — tenant-readiness discovery, Cloud PC provisioning/health validation, a Cloud PC fleet and license-utilization report, safe remediation (reprovision/resize helpers), and a provisioning-target group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Deploy and manage Windows 365 Cloud PCs at scale — provisioning policies, images, networking, and user assignment — secured and managed from Microsoft Intune like your physical fleet. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Deploy and manage Windows 365 Cloud PCs at scale — provisioning policies, images, networking, and user assignment, secured from Intune.
meta_description: Deploy Windows 365 Cloud PCs: provisioning policies, custom images, Azure network connection, user assignment, and Intune management/security. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Every eligible user with a dedicated, always-on Windows Cloud PC — provisioned by policy, secured and managed in Intune alongside physical devices, reachable from anywhere — proven on a pilot before you scale.

hero.tagline: DESKTOP IN MINUTES.  MANAGED LIKE METAL.
